composition_ideas.name: hook_first_arrangement
composition_ideas.instruction: Build a early_hook with the strongest motif, then vary drums/bass every 4-8 bars.

composition_ideas.name: melody_safe_low_end
composition_ideas.instruction: Keep sub centered, use unknown 808/bass, and duck or simplify when it masks melody/vocal.

composition_ideas.name: wide_top_mono_bottom
composition_ideas.instruction: Widen only high-passed synth or upper harmonics; keep low end mono below 120 Hz.

composition_ideas.name: vocal_identity_safe_fx
composition_ideas.instruction: Use unknown pitch-correction guidance and saturation as production traits only; preserve user voice identity.
